meta.description: Project-team supplements to fssai_phase1_rules.json. Kept separate so the official extraction stays untouched. Every entry here is a transparent engineering addition, not an FSSAI quotation.

extra_hard_deny.note: Plain 'sugar' and 'glucose' are the most common added sugars but are missing from the base hard_deny_list.

vague_terms.message: This is a vague health/diet descriptor. FSSAI Phase-1 rules give it no measurable threshold, so it cannot be verified from the label and may create a misleading impression.
vague_terms.source: PROJECT.md section 7 lists 'Healthy' among high-risk terms; the remaining words come from front-of-pack claims in fmcg_label_audit_dataset.csv.

implied_rules.source: fmcg_label_audit_dataset.csv row 23 compliance_clause: "Using the term 'Diet' or 'Lite' requires meeting statutory low-fat criteria under FSSAI Advertising regulations." 'Naturally sweetened' is treated as a no-added-sugar promise (row 4).
